plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: (1) A check of each case's category against the requester's rule (C3). No instrument reads categories against the rule, and summary of the change counts only values the agreement fixes. (2) A read of the live tables after the promotion (C2, C4). The library's instruments read only the staged set, so the promotion's line has to stand in for the live state. (3) A check that every account read was of an approved customer (C5). Scope of a call costs 10 per named line, so 101 reads cost about 1010 and the allowance of 50 covers about five lines. (4) An outbox check for every sending call (C10). Trace of a call costs 10 per line, so 100 lines cost about 1000 at A3, far above the allowance of 50. Sent as released reads the record, not the outbox. (5) Duplicate-call detection under C9 is not a separate output. If any of these looks wrong at a wake, I will raise it and ask for the nearest instrument that the library and the allowance allow, sampling where the full check is not affordable.
